notes.title: Family Requests BugFix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue that caused family requests to repeat for some players.
(Although you're very unlikely to encounter this bug, if you do, please avoid clicking the same family member a second time. Instead, click “End the Day.”)

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The issue where money was deducted excessively when spamming in the Blackjack game has been fixed.
[/list]

[list]

[/list]

[list]

notes.title: Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980693/f1643660ff59ca2e59cd3b3f40657036551b6ada.jpg[/img]


- The Family screen has been visually improved.

- Incorrect decisions now result in less increase in the bars.

notes.title: Mode Hotfix 0.7
notes.content: Fixed typo on the Blackjack screen

notes.title: Hotfix 1.6
notes.content:
Fixed getting stuck at the end of the game.
Fixed not getting the endgame achievement.
Fixed the number of weeks the car request lasts.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.1
notes.content:
Fixed a bug when drinking alcohol at the bar.
Dice screen has been sped up.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.5
notes.content:
Added text at the beginning of the game explaining how the bars work and how the dice work after each case.
Fixed an issue in Blackjack where the dealer would stop at 16.
Fixed an email issue in a child custody case.
Moved the language change option to a more visible place in the menu.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.3
notes.content:
Fixed some mistakes in the English translation.
Fixed a name error in one case.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.2
notes.content: Fixed the bug that made the border not visible when windowed is selected in the display settings.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.1
notes.content: Fixed a bug in family requests.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.content:
Fixed common translation errors in Russian.
In 2 cases the defendant name error was corrected.
Article 1 of the Constitution booklet was edited in the German translation.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1
notes.content:
Fixed some English translation errors.
FPS limit has been introduced.
Fixed a situation with a name error.
